rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: The final Arabic component of the accepted num citation label, supplemented by every recursively encountered milestone unit=niese. Stable paragraph IDs do not establish section boundaries; six reviewed continuation labels contain no Niese number.
rules.textTransformations: Exclude verified citation labels, source annotations, incipits, explicits and external metadata. Trim each section-fragment edge. Represent a continuing physical paragraph boundary by two newlines. Preserve every other source character and all original words exactly.
rules.editorialMarkup: Retain add and del letters as searchable visible text, with their original source tags and attributes in editorialMarks. Do not silently apply a corrected reading or insert editorial punctuation.
rules.transparentMarkup: Preserve s and ref text; retain their distinct spans and attributes in sourceMarkup. The s wrapper encloses internal Niese milestones102 and103; traverse recursively.
rules.structuralMarkup: pb and Bamberg anchor contribute no characters or spaces. Internal Niese markers establish citations; the Proem niese-end terminates26. Report each marker and its original coordinate.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Proem and narrative are separate source divisions: I.27 has breakBefore. III.240 is an explicitly omitted empty Latin unit, with a zero-width gap and phraseBreaks[0]; III.241 also has breakBefore. Six literal dot clusters conservatively block phrase adjacency without changing their scholarly interpretation. Ordinary consecutive sections and continuing paragraph fragments remain joinable in whole-book scope.
rules.unknownContent: Unknown substantive markup, attributes, headings, continuation labels or unmarked empty sections stop extraction for review.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Every non-whitespace indexed character is original running source text. Each raw parsed paragraph is exactly restored from finished record slices plus recorded labels, notes and trimmed whitespace. Generated paragraph separators are whitespace only.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText, flat and recordText offsets are zero-based Python Unicode-character offsets, end exclusive. Published editorialMarks, sourceMarkup, textGaps and phraseBreaks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start and L/M/N continuation, original word strings without normalization or stemming.
